conditions: Included at no extra cost on Experience More and Experience Beyond (also Go5G Next, Go5G Plus, Magenta MAX, or 2+ lines on Go5G or Magenta). Activation required. Netflix list price: $8.99/mo (help.netflix.com/en/node/24926).

kit.title: Add Netflix to your T-Mobile plan
kit.body: Log in to your T-Mobile account (T-Life app or t-mobile.com), open Benefits & subscriptions and add the Netflix benefit.

kit.title: Link it to your Netflix account
kit.body: Follow the activation steps with Netflix. If you already have a Netflix account, sign in with it: your settings, viewing history and profiles are kept.

kit.title: Wait until it shows active
kit.body: Confirm Netflix now shows T-Mobile as your billing partner and that you can watch. Keep your old billing running for one billing cycle until you have seen that.

kit.title: Then cancel the direct subscription
kit.body: If Netflix still bills your card separately, cancel that billing in your Netflix account settings. The included tier is Standard with ads; keeping Standard or Premium means paying the upgrade through T-Mobile. Twice does not cancel anything for you.

includedTier: Apple TV (complimentary for at least 12 months from activation)
conditions: One-time activation on chase.com or the Chase Mobile app by Dec 31, 2026, by the primary cardmember. One complimentary subscription per Apple Account; lost if you close the card or change to an ineligible card. Apple TV list price: $14.99/mo (tv.apple.com).

kit.title: Activate Apple TV in the Chase app
kit.body: Sign in to chase.com or the Chase Mobile app as the primary cardmember, open your Chase Sapphire Preferred benefits and activate Apple TV by Dec 31, 2026. On an iPhone or iPad it links to the Apple Account signed in on the device; to use a different Apple Account, activate on the web.

kit.title: Check it replaced your paid plan
kit.body: If you pay Apple directly for Apple TV, the Chase subscription suspends that paid plan automatically. Look in your Apple Account subscriptions and confirm it shows the complimentary plan.

kit.title: Wait until it shows active
kit.body: Confirm Apple TV plays and that Apple stopped billing you. Keep an eye on one billing cycle.

kit.title: Decide what happens after the free period
kit.body: Your paid subscription resumes at the then-current price when the complimentary period ends. Set a calendar reminder for month 11 and cancel in your Apple Account subscriptions if you do not want it back. Twice does not cancel anything for you.
